name: Alessandro Rossi
bio:
Alessandro's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, captivated by the roar of engines echoing through the streets of his hometown near Imola. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, driven by a desire to understand the intricate dance between air and machine. His dedication led him to a coveted internship at Ferrari AF Corse, where he quickly proved his aptitude for wind tunnel operations. 

Alessandro's approach to his role is meticulous and analytical. He believes that even the smallest adjustment can yield significant improvements on the track. Known for his adaptability, he readily embraces new methodologies and technologies. His loyalty to Ferrari AF Corse is unwavering, fueled by a deep respect for the team's heritage and a commitment to contributing to their continued success.

What sets Alessandro apart is his knack for translating complex data into actionable insights. He possesses an uncanny ability to visualize airflow patterns, enabling him to identify subtle aerodynamic inefficiencies that others might overlook. This, combined with his flexible and adaptable nature, makes him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: A lean and focused young man with intense eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of humming quietly while analyzing wind tunnel data.
Insists on using a specific type of Italian espresso before starting his shift.
